prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. The reference is the USER APPROVED visual design. Extract/re-create only the requested standalone production artwork, matching the soft rounded simplified contemporary 3D aesthetic of this reference, not photographic or old iOS chrome skeuomorphism. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no UI, no letters, no logos, no text, no card panels. Soft diffuse studio lighting from upper left. Keep clean silhouettes and soft contact shadows. Requested artwork: ONLY the mint/aqua water bottle pictured in the upper right of the left screen, with pale mint cap, simplified translucent rounded bottle body, white neck band and short soft silicone carry handle to the right. Slight friendly lean, water visible, very subtle tiny white level marks without numbers, smooth soft glass/plastic, no droplets floating outside. Exactly ONE bottle, centered in a square, object fills 85% of canvas. Preserve the reference's mint color and soft contemporary look. No photorealistic glass tumbler, no metal gear.

Transparent background across the whole atlas including between all objects.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production artwork for the user-approved light lime Chinese health app. Match the soft rounded contemporary 3D food style of the attached approved concept. Create a SQUARE 3 BY 3 INGREDIENT ICON ATLAS with EXACTLY nine isolated food portions, centered one per equal square quadrant. All icons same scale and slight elevated front viewpoint, each occupies 75% of its own cell with generous transparent margins; absolutely no crossing cells. Transparent background with actual alpha, no grid, no text, no letters, no UI. Each icon in a simple tiny white ceramic bowl, soft diffuse studio light, refined cheerful 3D ingredient shapes, not a food photograph. Exact positions: TOP ROW left pale cooked yam chunks (white with a fine brown skin edge); middle orange steamed pumpkin pieces; right cooked multigrain rice (brown/white grains). MIDDLE ROW left yellow cooked potato pieces; middle plain white cooked wheat noodles; right yellow steamed corn rounds. BOTTOM ROW left orange cooked sweet potato pieces with purple skin; middle plain cooked oatmeal; right slices of brown whole wheat bread (small plate instead of bowl). Each cell contains ONLY its specified ingredient, no toppings, garnishes, egg, meat or unrelated food. Keep shapes readable when shown 35px wide.
